jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Job Summary :

The selected candidate will be responsible for providing assistance in managing and maintaining the Altair One platform, as well as implementing and deploying applications in both Cloud and On-Premises environments.

They will work closely with the team to ensure smooth and efficient operation of the platform, while also troubleshooting issues as they arise.

The ideal candidate should have a solid understanding of Cloud and On-Premises deployment methods and be able to work collaboratively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

Job Requirements :

2+ years of experience in DevOps / SRE, systems engineering, build / release / deployment automation, Public / Private / Hybrid cloud deployment, etc.

2+ years of experience in Azure,AWS,GCP, or OCI is necessary.

Strong Docker and Kubernetes skills are required.

Familiarity with working on an Agile / Iterative development framework.

Experience with modern deployment mechanisms like Canary, and Blue Green.

Experience... with Infrastructure as Code Tooling Terraform orAWS CloudFormation orAzure ARM.

Experience with Configuration Management tools such as Salt Stack, Ansible, Chef, and Puppet.

Experience with Application Observability / Metrics Grafana stack, Honeycomb, Prometheus, Loki, etc.

Experience with Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment Pipelines - Jenkins CI, GitLab CI / CD, Flux or ArgoCD.

DevOps tooling (GitLab, Jenkins, GitHub, Jira, Jenkins DSL, Hashi Corp Vault, Consul, Boundary, Istio, Packer,Linkerd, Kapitan, Helm, Kedaetc.)

Experience with Windows and Linux administration.

Understanding of High-PerformanceComputing (HPC) is a plus.

Job Responsibilities :

Debug Production issues by working with the Development and Operations team.

Understand and improve the reliability and scaling of Production deployments.

Deploy microservices on Cloud and On-premises K8s environments.

Provide quick fixes and solutions and rollout software fixes to Production.

Develop scripts to automate routine tasks.

Research innovative technology and solution alternatives to find the best solutions to problems.

Set up monitoring and alerting systems to detect issues before they become problems, ensuring our systems are always available.

Analyse Requirements and proactively estimate and project the requirements for infrastructure, security, and DevOps initiatives.

How You Will Be Successful :
• Envision the Future
• Communicate Honestly and Broadly
• Seek Technology and Business Firsts
• Embrace Diversity and Take Risks

What We Offer :
• Competitive benefits and salary
• A great team with very friendly and highly skilled peers
• Flexible working hours and possibility to work either fully remote, or work from our office in Budapest
• Private health insurance
• Gym membership reimbursement
• Extra vacation days
• SZÉP Card
• Health days in the office with monthly massage

jobs_results.title: DevOps Manager
jobs_results.description:
DevOps ManagerLocation: Barcelona

This is what you will do:

The DevOps Manager will be a key role in the Digital team. This individual will be the Service Delivery Manager and subject matter expert for DevSecOps projects and operations. The Candidate will promote and champion DevOps practices at Alexion and help enable the tools required to set up CI/CD pipelines.

You will be responsible for:
• Establishing stable, secure and scalable DevOps infrastructureEnsuring timely and effective responses to DevOps related incidents
• Analyzing IT and business processes to identify DevOps opportunities
• Driving the adoption and continuous refinement of DevOps methodologies and tools
• Leading the end to end delivery of DevOps solutions
• Leading partner resources and their outcome
• Maintaining an uptodate understanding of emerging trends and technologies in the DevOps space and proactively identifying opportunities for improvement
• Promoting standardization and best practices for version... control, build artifacts and deployment.

You will need to have:
• Minimum 4 years of experienceBachelor/Master in Information Technology
• Deep knowledge of cloud platformsDeep knowledge of DevOps components and toolsHandson experience implementing DevOps infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines
• Strong analytical and communication skills
• Ability to collaborate across teams and be a standout colleague
• Ability to work independently and quickly absorb new technologies

We would prefer for you to have:
• Deep knowledge specific to the following platforms and tools both in Cloud and privately deployed versions or offerings: GitHub, Jenkins, Kubernetes, AWS, EKSCertifications in cloud platforms, DevOps, or related areas.
• Experience in the pharmaceutical or healthcare and life sciences industry.
• Knowledge of best practices and regulations related to data security and privacy in the healthcare sector.
• Familiarity with Agile methodologies

AstraZeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
That thing we do

We're the Operating System for the Music Industry - a platform that pumps up the jam of every play.

We connect all players of the industry to amplify the value of music. Driven by machine learning and copyright expertise, our system pumps neutral data and authoritative knowledge to everyone along the chain. For those who make or use music, we allow them to plug in to our O.S. to ease operations, increase earnings, and get in sync with everyone else.

What You'll Be Doing

Your main responsibility will be to maintain and continuously improve our systems infrastructure, automating key processes such as setup, deployment and monitoring. You are expected to proactively take care of our platforms like your own little tech babies, improving your skills in the process and staying up to date with the latest technologies.

Requirements

You must have
• Experience setting up and maintaining cloud infrastructure in AWS
• Experience using Terraform, Ansible, Kubernetes, Git and... Docker for continuous integration
• Proficiency in networks and security (VPN, routing, firewalls)
• Your natural OS is Linux
• You use your knowledge of Shell and Python automation tools to avoid repeating yourself
• You are organized in your work, and love monitoring and logging your platforms
• You have English working proficiency
• You are an excellent team player

It would be great if you also have:
• Our tech stack is mainly Python, AWS, MongoDB, Elastic
• Git proficiency
• Jenkins experience

Benefits

You Can Enjoy
• Flexible working hours and location
• Unlimited time off because we believe that you know best when you need to rest
• We'll provide you with all equipment needed for you to be comfortable
• Flat hierarchy
• You can make the role your own and run your own development
• Online language classes to improve your Spanish, Catalan or English
• Online and onsite courses and music industry workshops run by inhouse experts
• Barcelona HQ office available to you, kitted out with a rehearsal room https://www.bmat.com/bmat-house/

Who The FAQ Are BMAT

BMAT started in 2005 when a group of engineers with a passion for music decided to spin-off from an audio research lab in Barcelona. We're now over 200 people, spread across Barcelona, Buenos Aires, Lima, Rio de Janeiro, London, Paris, Nairobi, Oslo, Tel-Aviv, Singapore, Tokyo, Manila, Bangkok and Lagos.

We're a team of pretty decent people who enjoy working with each other. We're open-minded and well-traveled, coming from all parts of the world. We've got rappers, producers, cello players, DJs, and songwriters. The passion for music, the excitement for innovative technology and Barcelona as a backdrop has proven to make a good combination.

Join us from wherever you are on our mission to help make music live forever.

We say there's a BMAT touch. We believe it has to do with being passionate, obsessive, nice, generous, honest, self-motivated, entrepreneurial, intrepid, crazy, extraordinary, creative, agile, human, friendly, smart, witty, talented, naive, optimistic, surprising, sensual, and nerdy, but not very hipster (unfortunately). Our way of being is always sprinkled with transparency, perseverance, flexibility, open-mindedness and trustworthiness.

Diverse perspectives drive innovation, and innovation is kind of our thing. Our open-minded and flexible culture organically fosters this diversity. We've learnt that we thrive on learning from each other, so we don't just welcome but actively hire a range of open-minded people from all walks of life. Our team is made up of people with different backgrounds, perspectives, orientations, abilities, musical tastes, dress sense and time-zones - but we all have one common goal: Making the music world a better place. With equal opportunities for everyone, BMAT is a pretty nice place to work

jobs_results.title: Senior DevOps Cloud Engineer (Azure IOT Cloud) (d/f/m)
jobs_results.company_name: TK ELEVATOR IBERICA HOLDING, SL UNIPERSONAL
jobs_results.description:
People are at the center of everything we do at TK Elevator – we work as one team, watch out for each other’s safety and share a common vision to keep the world moving. This is your chance to go beyond and impact the future of urban mobility. We are looking for talented people who want to start or develop their professional career with us.

With integrated cloud-based solutions such as our MAX platform, we embrace the full potential of digitalization, transforming ourselves into a digitally augmented company to make life easier, more efficient and more comfortable.

TK Elevator aims to be a leader in industrial IoT solutions, data enabled solutions software solutions that make our customers and users successful and happy. Jointly with leading technology companies as strategic partners, we have just released our first Digital Native Elevator EOX. We will continue this journey - to improve the lives of people everywhere, every day.

You will co-drive this journey with a dynamic and... growing team that uses leading technology and works in a truly global setup to solve challenging problems, develop new business solutions and digital products.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Cloud DevOps Engineer specializing in Azure in IoT and data solutions. This role is pivotal in ensuring the seamless operation and reliability of our MAX IoT Platform. As a Senior Cloud DevOps Engineer, you will support maintaining Azure-based IoT solutions, providing scalability, fostering cross-functional collaboration, and mentoring other members of the team.
• Responsible for the continuous availability and reliability of the connected systems
• Test and maintain Azure Cloud-based IoT & data backend solutions
• Provide proper scalability of the entire system backend
• Achieve an expert understanding of the end-to-end architecture and ecosystem
• Support with Test automation – unit testing and integration testing
• Be an active member of the global DevOps community
• Support planning for performance, uptime, disaster recovery, and capacity growth
• Over 5 years’ experience of the software development life cycle, using Azure Cloud technology
• Knowledgeable on the Microsoft platform and have built up technical mastery on the key technologies like C# & .NET.
• Solid coding experience, especially in cloud, mobile, and web environments.
• Experience with large, complex, and highly scalable systems
• DevOps tool experience (Visual Studio Team Services preferred)
• Programming and scripting experience, Process Automation (.Net, SQL, Angular)
• Continuous integration and delivery experience
• Automated Testing (Unit, Integration, Functional)
• Cloud Development and Deployment (Azure PaaS preferred)
• Reliable problem-solving skills/debugging/data mining skills
• Target-group appropriate communication skills with business experts and product teams including developers, Pos, testers and Designers
• Proficient English communication skills, both written and spoken
• Secure job and salary – permanent contract in a technically exciting, stable, and sustainable industry and an attractive compensation package
• Social benefits and an attractive work calendar.
• Teamwork & safety – an open, transparent, and value-oriented culture
• Individualized training plan from your very first day.
• TK Elevator is a company with an open, transparent culture that focuses on the people who make it up. At TKE you will receive frequent feedback, continuous training and space to contribute your ideas

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Role: DevOps Engineer
Location: Valencia, Spain
Salary: up to €60,000
Working model: Mostly remote, 80% home office

Join a dynamic team as a skilled Site Reliability/DevOps Engineer! We're on the lookout for a seasoned professional with interest in creating innovative solutions. In this role, you'll be at the forefront of managing and advancing intricate cloud solutions for a global clientele. Collaborating closely with development teams, you'll ensure a robust working environment while actively contributing to the enhancement of the Internal Developer Platform.

Key Qualifications:
• Minimum 2 years of experience in overseeing Cloud-based infrastructures
• Proficient in IaC, DevOps, and GitOps concepts
• Expertise in CI/CD, Docker Containers, and Kubernetes
• Hands-on experience with cloud providers such as GCP, AWS, or Azure
• Openness to learning programming languages, especially Elixir
• Familiarity with pipeline management (Gitlab CI/CD) and Kubernetes administration
• Strong... problem-solving intuition

And, most importantly:
• Ability to influence and collaborate effectively with colleagues
• EU citizenship or valid work permit
• Willingness to work at the office at least twice a week

Benefits:
• Flexible hybrid work model
• 5 weeks of vacation
• Attractive office in Valencia city center with free coffee and snacks
• Flat hierarchy, state-of-the-art infrastructure
• Supportive company culture valuing every opinion
• Semi-annual dialogue talks for professional and personal growth
• International networking through events and conferences
• Generous annual well-being allowance
• Dedicated learning time and budget
• Generous 5-year anniversary present
• Private accident insurance coverage in Switzerland

If you're ready to bring your expertise to a dynamic environment and contribute to cutting-edge solutions, we invite you to apply. Join us and be a vital part of our innovative journey!

Evelyn Hay - Recruitment partner

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
¿Qué hacemos?

En FS Consulting – Microsoft Group asesoramos a las Entidades Financieras y Compañías Aseguradoras en la definición de su estrategia tecnológica con soluciones de Microsoft en cuatro ámbitos principales - Business Aplications (Dynamics y Power Platform), Data & AI (Machine Learning, Data Science, Power BI), Cloud (Azure) y Workplace (M365). Colaboramos en la selección e implantación de soluciones tecnológicas de Microsoft que permiten a nuestros clientes acelerar en su transformación digital, actuando cómo su "trusted-advisor" y colaborando de forma conjunta para alcanzar el éxito en todos sus retos. Nuestra misión: Ayudar a nuestros clientes a maximizar y aprovechar las capacidades de las tecnologias y soluciones de Microsoft.

Actualmente, ampliamos el equipo con un/a DevOps Engineer.

¿Qué podrás hacer?
• Participar en proyectos tecnológicos de primer nivel dentro de la plataforma de MSFT.
• Desarrollar tu carrera profesional en un equipo de trabajo multidisciplinar... y asumir retos apasionantes.
• Gestionar la solución final del cliente, revisando sus procesos y aportando valor en base a las mejores prácticas de la herramienta.
• Compartir espacio con una comunidad de excelentes profesionales dentro del ámbito de Microsoft en KPMG.
• Formación contínua y certificacionesv Microsoft.
• Participación y acceso a eventos de la comunidad y de Microsoft.

¿Qué necesitas saber?
• Al menos cinco años de experiencia en proyectos de DevOps (Azure principalmente).
• Desarrollo de estrategia de DevOps: Colaborar con nuestro cliente para desarrollar y perfeccionar la estrategia de DevOps de la organización, definiendo metas, objetivos y métricas de éxito. Evaluar el estado actual de las prácticas de DevOps e identificar áreas de mejora.
• Integración continua e implementación continua (CI/CD): Diseño, implementación y administración de canalizaciones de CI/CD mediante Azure DevOps Services o Azure DevOps Server. Definición de procesos de compilación y lanzamiento, automatización de pruebas e implementación de aplicaciones en entornos de Azure.
• Infraestructura como código (IaC): Automatización de la infraestructura utilizando herramientas como plantillas de Azure Resource Manager (ARM), Terraform o Azure DevTest Labs. Definición de configuraciones de infraestructura como código para el aprovisionamiento y la administración automatizada de recursos de Azure.
• Monitorización y registro: Conocimiento de herramientas de registro como Azure Monitor, Azure Log Analytics y Azure Application Insights. Configuración de soluciones de supervisión para realizar un seguimiento del rendimiento, la disponibilidad y el estado de los recursos y aplicaciones de Azure.
• Seguridad y cumplimiento: Implementación de prácticas recomendadas de seguridad para entornos de Azure, incluidos IAM, seguridad de red, cifrado y estándares de cumplimiento como GDPR, HIPAA y SOC. Asegurar que los procesos y la infraestructura de DevOps estén diseñados e implementados teniendo en cuenta la seguridad (DevSecOps).
• Conocimiento de lenguajes cómo PowerShell, Python, or Bash para automatización de tareas y gestión de recursos de Azure.
• Capacidad analítica y excelente nivel de interlocución con cliente.
• Nivel alto de inglés.
• Certificaciones a nivel Azure

• Participación y acceso a eventos de la comunidad y de Microsoft.

¿Qué necesitas saber?
• Al menos cinco años de experiencia en proyectos de DevOps (Azure principalmente).
• Desarrollo de estrategia de DevOps: Colaborar con nuestro cliente para desarrollar y perfeccionar la estrategia de DevOps de la organización, definiendo metas, objetivos y métricas de éxito. Evaluar el estado actual de las prácticas de DevOps e identificar áreas de mejora.
• Integración continua e implementación continua (CI/CD): Diseño, implementación y administración de canalizaciones de CI/CD mediante Azure DevOps Services o Azure DevOps Server. Definición de procesos de compilación y lanzamiento, automatización de pruebas e implementación de aplicaciones en entornos de Azure.
• Infraestructura como código (IaC): Automatización de la infraestructura utilizando herramientas como plantillas de Azure Resource Manager (ARM), Terraform o Azure DevTest Labs. Definición de configuraciones de infraestructura como código para el aprovisionamiento y la administración automatizada de recursos de Azure.
• Monitorización y registro: Conocimiento de herramientas de registro como Azure Monitor, Azure Log Analytics y Azure Application Insights. Configuración de soluciones de supervisión para realizar un seguimiento del rendimiento, la disponibilidad y el estado de los recursos y aplicaciones de Azure.
• Seguridad y cumplimiento: Implementación de prácticas recomendadas de seguridad para entornos de Azure, incluidos IAM, seguridad de red, cifrado y estándares de cumplimiento como GDPR, HIPAA y SOC. Asegurar que los procesos y la infraestructura de DevOps estén diseñados e implementados teniendo en cuenta la seguridad (DevSecOps).
• Conocimiento de lenguajes cómo PowerShell, Python, or Bash para automatización de tareas y gestión de recursos de Azure.
• Capacidad analítica y excelente nivel de interlocución con cliente.
• Nivel alto de inglés.
• Certificaciones a nivel Azure

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer Senior / OTC
jobs_results.description:
Company Description

At T-Systems, you will find groundbreaking projects that contribute to social and ecological well-being. We want to welcome new talents like you, who bring fresh ideas, different perspectives, embrace challenges, and are committed to continuous learning in order to grow and make an impact on society... all in a fun way!

It doesn't matter when or where you work. It's about doing meaningful work that advances society. For this reason, we will do everything possible to ensure that you have all the development opportunities by providing a support network, excellent technology, a new work environment, and the freedom to work autonomously. We support you in growing both personally and professionally so that you can make a notable impact on society.

T-Systems is a team of around 28,000 employees worldwide, making us one of the leading global providers of end-to-end integrated solutions. We develop hybrid cloud solutions, artificial intelligence, and drive the digital... transformation of companies, industries, the public sector, and ultimately, society as a whole.

Job Description

CV in English is mandatory. We run Open Telekom Cloud! Open Telekom Cloud is a public cloud standard product based on open source community software and driven by principles of DevSecOps. Lean structures, agile methods, highly motivated teams and an extremely dynamic business environment determine our actions. With this customer-oriented and agile orientation, we are the anchor point for the Public Cloud business in Deutsche Telekom Group. We are measured by delivering a secure, stable and innovative platform. We work jointly with our platform partner and other partners out of the OpenStack ecosystem to create a highly innovative public cloud product based on European security and data protection standards. We are looking for people who are professionals and evangelists with a great deal of enthusiasm for cloud technology and who are up to the challenges created by the development and operation of a hyper-scale public cloud. We offer a unique insight into how a large public cloud works under the hood, intercultural teamwork, flat hierarchies and an independent work-style.

Implementation of web application which allows OTC (Open Telekom Cloud) users design their cloud applications and auto-deploy their applications on OTC in a few minutes. Web application also include OTC market place, which allows users develop application components (e.g., a mongo database), and import the components to the designer by themselves.

Qualifications

We are working on innovative projects. We do not need to know everything at the beginning but we learn during our work.

Requirements:
• English Intermediate+ (able to participate in technical discussions)
• Experience with Ansible
• Experience with Kubernetes
• Experience with Terraform
• Experience with OpenStack or similar solutions
• Knowledge of networking and virtualization

Optional:
• Experience in Golang
• Experience in Java Spring
• Experience with Angular
• Experience with Elasticsearch

Additional Information

What do we offer you?
• International, positive, dynamic, and motivated work environment.
• Hybrid work model (telework/face-to-face).
• Flexible schedule.
• Continuous training.
• Flexible Compensation Plan.
• Life and accident insurance.
• More than 25 working days of vacation per year.
• And many more advantages of being part of T-Systems!

If you are looking for a new challenge, do not hesitate to send us your CV! Please send CV in English. Join our team!

T-Systems Iberia will only process the CVs of candidates who meet the requirements specified for each offer

jobs_results.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Overview

About us

We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.

As a trusted voice for many of the world's most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.

About Energy Systems

We help customers navigate the complex transition to a decarbonized and more sustainable energy future. We do this by assuring that energy systems work safely and effectively, using solutions that are increasingly digital. We also help industries and governments to navigate the many complex, interrelated transitions taking place globally and regionally, in the energy industry.
About the role

Are you a DevOps Engineer looking to make a meaningful impact... in the renewable energy industry? Embrace this opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies and collaborate with a team of skilled professionals. Join our green revolution! Apply now to be at the heart of it.

What to expect?

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you will play a critical role in the design, implementation, and maintenance of our infrastructure. You will be responsible for ensuring reliability and scalability of our applications, optimizing our deployment processes, and using properly our resources.

Your day to day will include:
• Develop and implement strategies for infrastructure management, CI/CD, and cloud operations,
• Guide technically the implementation of network security and policies,
• Coordinate with other departments to understand their needs and provide solutions,
• Stay update with the latest trends and technologies, and apply this knowledge to improve processes and tools,
• Manage budgets and licenses related to DevOps tools and services,
• Foster a culture of continuous improvement and innovation within the team.

This role presents an exciting opportunity to join a growing team, with the possibility for individuals to take on leadership roles and expand their responsibilities to lead a small team in the future.

The team awaiting you

You will join a dynamic team dedicated to ensuring the reliable and secure operation of our cutting-edge GPM products and maintaining the robustness and scalability of the IT infrastructure, ultimately enhancing efficiency. We work together to design and manage a scalable and dynamic infrastructure that seamlessly integrates both on-site and cloud solutions, embracing the latest technological advancement.

Our team is at the forefront of driving automation enhancements, integrating advanced monitoring tools and practices. We uphold a high-availability service framework, meticulously develop and test disaster recovery plans, and ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards and requirements. Embracing a working culture built on continuous improvement, security awareness, resilience, and scalability, we invite you to be a part of our journey towards excellence.

GreenPowerMonitor and Solutions (GPM&S) is at the heart of the global energy transformation. We use data-driven digital solutions to optimise the performance of renewable energy installations around the world. Our work contributes to a more diverse, more sustainable global energy mix.

What we offer

Our benefits package is specifically designed to support your physical, financial and social well-being:
• Great atmosphere of working together with professionals and some of the most engaged and knowledgeable people in the industry.
• Receive guidance from colleagues through coaching, mentoring and participating in international networks.
• Advance your professional skills and technical expertise, through individual competence development plans and tailored training.
• Be part of a world growing and renowned organization with origins dating back to 1864.

Other than that you can expect:
• Medical Scheme
• Commuting Allowance
• Life Insurance
• Pension Plan
• Kindergarten Allowance
• 40 hours per week with a flexible schedule
• Home working allowance (up to 2 days per week)
• 23 days of annual leave
• Employee Referral scheme.
DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.
About you

Which skills to bring?

To thrive and succeed, we expect you to have:
• In-depth knowledge of Kubernetes and container orchestration, including experience in deploying and scaling containers in production environments
• Proven experience in Azure Devops, Terraform, Kubernetes, Calico and Kubeflow
• Strong leadership skills and experience managing a technical team
• Excellent problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills
• Familiarity with agile methodologies and fast-paced work environment
• Fluent in English and Spanish.

And if youve got these in your back pocket, consider it a bonus:
• Experience implementing and managing robust, high-available architectures
• Knowledge in infrastructure and application security
• Knowledge in relational and non-relational dbms.

jobs_results.title: Cloud DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
The Company

HP is a Fortune 100 technology company with $58+ Billion in revenue, with over 50,000 employees operating in more than 170 countries around the world. We provide technology and services that help people and companies address their problems and challenges, and realize their possibilities, aspirations and dreams. We apply new thinking and ideas to create simpler, more valuable and trusted experiences with technology, continuously improving the way our customers live and work.

Position background

In the GTM analytics COE our mission is to deliver impact by building machine learning products to optimize pricing and marketing investments and provide guidance to our sales organization.

Within the Cloud Infrastructure team, we are ensuring that our Data Science teams have all the technology assets they need to build and deliver the AI/ML solutions they work on as well that our Big Data environment is secure and has an up time of 99.99999%. As a Cloud Engineer you will... contribute to the success of our team thru the development of new solutions, infrastructures, and maintenance of existing ones for which you will ensure their compliance with security policies.

We offer an international experience, collaborative culture, top rate experience in AI and ML and opportunity to create significant real-world impact.

What you will do
• Designs and establishes secure and performant data architectures.
• Deliver enhancements, updates and programming changes for portions and subsystems of infrastructure hosting data pipelines, repositories and models for structured/unstructured data.
• Analyzes design and determines coding, programming, and integration activities required based on general objectives and knowledge of overall architecture of product or solution.
• Write and executes complete testing plans, protocols, and documentation for assigned portion of data system or component.
• Identify, debug and create solutions for issues with code and integration into data system architecture.
• Collaborates and communicates with project team regarding project progress and issue resolution.
• Represents the infrastructure team supporting the data engineering for all phases of larger and more-complex development projects.
• Provides guidance and mentoring to less experienced staff members.
• Investigate and suggest ways to improve and reduce operational costs.

What you will need:
• Bachelor’s in computer engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics or a related field
• 4+ years on a similar role.
• Ability to work under pressure as well as in autonomous mode.
• In-depth knowledge of provisioning and managing on-premises Windows physical and virtual infrastructure using Hyper-V.
• In-depth knowledge of provisioning and managing cloud services on Microsoft Azure.
• Review and Implement DevOps best practices, apply CI and CD principles (best practice) in supporting the build & release life cycle.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to represent complex algorithms in software.
• Strong understanding of database technologies and management systems, in particular Microsoft SQL Server and Azure SQL database services.
• Experience on database architecture testing methodology, including execution of test plans, debugging, and testing scripts and tools.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills; mastery in English and local language.
• Experience designing data systems/solutions to manage complex data and ability to effectively communicate product architectures, design.
• Experience with container orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes.
• Strong experience in at least one of the following languages: Python, Java, C#, .NET Core and .Net framework.
• Experience with IaC frameworks such as Azure Resource Manager, Terraform, Microsoft PowerShell.

Nice to Have
• Experience on Linux Operating Systems.
• Experience on NoSQL databases.
• Experience working on distributed computing systems.
• Experience with different cloud providers systems such as AWS or GCP

Who We Are

At HP, we believe in the power of ideas. We use ideas to put technology to work for everyone. And we believe that ideas thrive best in a culture of teamwork. That is why everyone – at every level in every function, is encouraged to think big, have original ideas and express and share them. We trust anything can be achieved if you really believe in it, and we will invest in your ideas to change lives and the way people work. This vision is what sets us apart as a company. At HP, we work across borders and without limits. Global virtual teams share resources, pool their big ideas to solve our biggest business opportunities. Everyone is valued for the unique skills, experiences and perspective they bring. That’s how we work at HP. And this is how ideas and people grow

jobs_results.title: Software Engineers (backend, devops, frontend)
jobs_results.description:
SynergyOS
• We are an early startup building a platform for the future of work: a productivity platform with content management and collaboration for the enterprise. Born as a remote team, we want to solve the big challenges in the office workflow to make a positive impact for millions of people around the world.
• We are looking for software engineers across backend, devops, and frontend. In this role, you will build an application that brings the best features and practices of software developers to the world of knowledge workers (finance, law, consulting). Imagine the power of git platforms but designed for office workers and Microsoft Office files.

The Roles
• Backend: Java and Spring Boot, Node.js. NoSQL databases. Microservices architecture.
• Frontend: TypeScript, React, React-native, Electron. Experience developing Windows native applications is a plus.
• DevOps: Kubernetes, object storage, and automations. All public clouds (Azure, Google Cloud, AWS) and on-premise... (MinIO).

Requirements
• Great person, communicator, and hard worker.
• Fluent in English. Spanish is a plus.
• 5+ years front-end development experience
